decision_basis: Primary collectin and macrophage studies support SFTPD engagement of SIRPA-associated inhibitory signaling and reduced phagocytic output. This recovers a bounded receptor-function program, but not a terminal TF or isolated SFTPD-only mechanism.

Primary receptor and endocrine studies support SHBG/GPRC6A engagement and receptor-dependent secretion responses. This recovers a bounded receptor program, but not a universal full-length SHBG mechanism or terminal TF.

Primary immune studies support SFTPD interaction with LAIR1 and suppression of an Fc-alpha-receptor inflammatory response. This recovers an exact receptor-proximal function program, but not a terminal TF.
Primary biochemical and developmental studies support VEGF-B/NRP1 binding and NRP1-dependent vascular or neuronal function. This recovers an isoform-bounded coreceptor program, but not a terminal TF.
Primary receptor studies support VIP binding and activation of PAC1/ADCYAP1R1 with receptor-dependent second-messenger output. This recovers an exact GPCR function program, but not a terminal TF.

Primary receptor-cloning and functional studies support VIP binding and activation of VPAC1/VIPR1 with receptor-dependent signaling. This recovers an exact GPCR function program, but not a terminal TF.
